description:
The same CPS shape with a list stack and a bare accumulator exhausts the 50,000-job fact-wait budget on interp/run/build. It compiles only when every threaded accumulator passes through an extern typed any (a type eraser), i.e. polyvariant specialization does not converge on the literal OTP algorithm. Reproducer: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/punch/02_budget_cps_list_stack.fz

Part of fz-mue (fz runs OTP's json.erl unchanged). Port and harness: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/.
title: A continuation-passing decoder with a list stack specializes within the budget
